title: Garle marih xin
intro: Imaan qawwalayla luk sugeeh, caylale mari imaan diggoysaanam faxan waktil, qunxaaneyti roocih qunxa butta, karmoomih addat qagaaqagitak doorit abte. oson yaaxigeenih yaniinim inkih kusak, qaleeli qeltut tan diteh addat dabboh gorrisak, sinni amaanat inkih Yallal daffeysen. Ciggiilak tekkem abaabisa marah wakti sinni asta akkele.
clues: Nanu qunxaaneytak sugne buttay ni Rabbil yaamineeh, Usug miracsental nee osise.
Nanu ninni ummattah foocal soolak Yallak iroh tan rabbitte inkinnah seece waynam diggosne.
Nanu gablah addat dabboh gorrisneeh, 'ni Rabbow isi nabsik racmatta neh yacaay, ni caagid gitah nee miraacis.'
Nanu mango sanootah xiineh, ayro ni gablak iroh obtaah, nee xagtam madudda.
Ni kuti gablah culmeenal fiddinowteh, waqlah innal nee dacrisak suge.
nanu xiinik ugte wak, nanu magide fan sugnem cakkumsitneeh, nek numuk teyni maaqo xaamuh lakqo qastiyaayi luk ruube.
